notes.title: Summer's Gambit - Part 3
notes.content:
Pilots! We are happy to present you the final part of the story about notorious Miss Summer!
[url=https://forum.star-conflict.com/index.php?/topic/28354-summers-gambit/](previous parts)[/url]

[img]http://img.targem.ru/images/fa6a9d156e049bae66201b070ab2.jpg[/img]

A figure in a pressurized suit is leaning over Henry. The smuggler found himself lying on a medical gurney. The man above him was fiddling with the straps on Henry’s left hand, but his right hand was still free. There was no time for reflection: the gradually returning sense of hearing was disturbed by the roar of sirens. Henry used all the strength in his numb hand and hit the person somewhere in the head, then turned and hit again with his foot. The man fell down, and Henry began to unfasten his left hand. To his surprise he found himself in the same suit.
 
He is now on the far side of the hangar, not far from the ‘Turtle’. Chaos reigned all around him. He heard shots of kinetic carbines and squeals of combat blasters. Ships sped by, one by one — pirates were leaving the station in a hurry. Whatever happened here, Henry decided to follow their example as soon as possible. A few seconds later he unfastened the straps, and he was free. The man who’d tried to fasten him to a gurney, meanwhile, jumped to his feet and ran somewhere in the direction of the hangar entrance.
 
There was no time to investigate. And even more so there was no point to catch up with the stranger. Thuds and rhythmic beats of kinetic weapons were heard from the place where he’d fled. One of the pirates jumped into his ship,but pointed his guns at the hangar.
 
Henry reacted at the last moment, when a mad technician jumped at him. The man in the green suit was running towards him, swinging a heavy wrench. The smuggler grabbed the gurney and pushed it at the attacker. He did not even try to dodge, got hit by it and fell down. Something was wrong with the technician. Henry looked closely at him and was horrified to find terrible blisters, swollen on the man’s neck. His eyes were covered by a bloody shroud, even the whites were red, and his mouth was foaming.
 
Henry cursed and rushed to the ‘Turtle’. His legs were still numb, as if he had been unconscious not for hours but for years. When he reached the ship, he jumped on the ramp of the cargo hold and hit the ‘Lift’ button. Only then did he realize that the ramp should have been closed. Henry turned to face the cargo, but the black box was still in place... yet the chains holding it were torn for some reason.
- This is not good. This is really, really bad, - he said to himself.
 
In the cockpit everything was as he had left it, even the bottle of protein brew. The smuggler collapsed in a chair and hit the ignition. ‘Turtle’ came to life, and the ship pulled away from the hangar floor. Henry guided it to the door, where he saw one of the pirate frigates. It was about to leave too, but suddenly changed the trajectory and released drones. The pirate was turning towards the ‘Turtle’. Henry yanked the wheel and went straight to the enemy. Pirate drones were clicking their lasers on the shield of the ‘Turtle’, but then vanished in an instant thanks to the coil mortar. Explosive shells turned them into scrap metal. Knock, knock, another blow — the smuggler was squeezing the trigger. Another pirate on an agile interceptor sped past, trying to break out of chaos that reigned in the hangar. He was caught by the blast for just a split-second, but it was enough. An interceptor was what entered the zone of fire, but just a flaming wreckage was all that was left of it. Henry’s enemy moved to position and immediately opened fire. Too late. ‘Turtle’ shields took the hit, strengthened by a multiphase adapter. The last two mortar charges hit the pirate’s hull, then the ships collided. The hull squealed, but held together. Pushing the pirate aside, Henry once again rushed for the exit. He was almost there already — where the force field was keeping oxygen from being sucked outside. But the pirate did not want to give up, he started turning once again.
- Get away! — Henry snapped and released the minelayer.
 
He did not even bother to watch what happened. He brought the vessel out of the hangar and immediately deployed a jump gate. There were too many ships and debris around: jumping was risky. But Henry knew that as soon as the pirates cleared through the minefield, he would’ve had dozens, or even hundreds of ships on his tail.
 
This time the gates opened. ‘Turtle’ together with Henry yanked forward. Acceleration was so strong that the Smuggler was pressed into his chair. And when the jump was over, they were already far from the station. An asteroid belt was visible ahead. Henry sent the ship there.
 
The intercom came to life.
- Good job, Henry, -—Miss Summer smiled on the screen — you did the right thing.
- What the ... — the smuggler stopped for a moment — what happened there?
- My people will greet you, — she ignored the question.
- No one is getting the cargo until I get an answer!
- Your cargo, Henry? — Summer continued to smile, but something in her eyes changed.
 
Something squealed inside the hull of the ‘Turtle’ once again. It looked like the battle was not too kind to it.
- What happened at the station? the Smuggler repeated his question.
- The baron decided to ignore part of our deal and he got what he deserved.
- Is that a threat?
Summer was silent. The squeal and rattle repeated. Henry realized that it was coming from the cargo hold.
- Emperor, Bartle and Federal senators be damned, who the heck are you?
- I am the one whose orders are always followed. That's all you need to know.
The image of the beautiful stranger was suddenly distorted with noise and began to dissolve on the screen. A strange kind of symbol appeared instead — a pyramid with three spikes and an eye.
- You disobeyed my orders, Henry — Summer's voice lost all emotion, it sounded mechanical. — And now you are going to pay for it.
Henry flicked the intercom and realized that it wasn’t an incoming call. Years of flights alone made him forget what the ship’s internal comms looked like
- Oh, no... — the smuggler whispered.
The rattle became permanent... and it was getting closer. Something was making its way to the cockpit through the ship’s wiring. The radar came on. It was showing ships hiding among asteroids. Three, five, ten, fifteen... there were at least three dozen. The broadcast was suddenly clogged with mechanical noise — those were Cybers.
- Henry... — the mechanical voice rang out behind him — I always get what I want.
- Oh, no, — he said, and turned on the jump gate — not this time.
 
Through the windshield, Henry Twenty-One was watching his own death. When the ‘Turtle’, crashing against the rocks, disappeared from the radar, he finally took off his helmet. Blood had dried up on his face. He looked at his reflection in the clear helmet visor. The stitches were split from the blow. It was pretty bad, but not as bad as what he had done to save his own skin.
 
There was no sense in staying. The smuggler turned his ‘Nyx’ to the system gate. Away from the infected plant, away from the asteroid belt, and away from himself. The only thing that warmed his soul, was the thought that the death of Henry Twenty-Two was instant.
 
The end.
 
Author: P. Shabarin

notes.title: 3D Model of ‘Monolith’
notes.content:
[img] http://img.targem.ru/images/c34cb68be075d0bb06add4c4a37a.png [/img]

notes.title: Halloween in Space
notes.content:
[img]http://img.targem.ru/images/a71f6f777313d82cf1337557c197.png[/img]

[h1]Attention, mercenaries! Centre has received a message from the Imperial Counterintelligence special section #0 ‘Inquisition’ under the Warden order.[/h1]

[b]‘Attention to all UMC pilots![/b]
 
Scientists report the approach of the next ‘Signal Peak’. Each year, at the end of October of Earth calendar, the universe experiences a passing wave of anomalous energy. It's time for the old Earth tradition called ‘Halloween’. Fanatics and cultists who worship the Signal think that on ‘Halloween’ dead souls penetrate into our world. Despite numerous reports of ghost ships and other abnormal phenomena, the Inquisition considers it its duty to inform you that all of this is pure fiction. Ghosts do not exist! Any cases of dissent should be reported to the nearest military command post.
 
Two years ago, a Jericho experiment ended in a disaster. Since then, all objects with the active signal were assigned the code name W.I.T.Ch. This year, a significant threat comes from the pilots infected with Liu virus. The forces opposing humanity have disguised virus canisters as holiday decorations!
‘W.I.T.Ch. Protocol’ is coming into force. High alert mode is introduced on all bases. Under the terms of the tripartite memorandum ‘On quarantine zones’ all three factions are co-operating on this matter.
Special agent of the Inquisition Miranda del Arte has been appointed to oversee the operation.
Mercenaries will receive special rewards for completing objectives and destroying W.I.T.Ches!’
 
Centre put forward the following objectives:

-Using ‘MEM Inquisitor’ missiles, destroy the ships of those mercenaries who are suspected of carrying the Alien virus. Infected are present among all combat roles — it is necessary to destroy at least one ship of each role.

-Follow the instructions of special agent of the Inquisition Miranda del Arte and destroy infected, marked by the Inquisition.
 
The top mercenaries will receive [b]an exclusive module[/b] for their ships, and in addition, [b]a special achievement[/b] and [b]a special title[/b]!

notes.title: 3D Model of ‘Cyning’
notes.content:
[img] http://img.targem.ru/images/c65467c31804d44f271bbe794167.png [/img]

Built to conduct combat reconnaissance in extreme conditions, the first prototype of the ship ‘Cyning’ was the sole survivor of an Alien attack on the 112th Imperial Design Bureau. Equipped only with basic weapons, ‘Cyning’ managed to take down some of the attackers and then fled. Fortunately, it was carrying the engineers responsible for the project, and all the documentation. Once they were safe, the engineers made several amendments to their records, and only then went into medical rehabilitation. The ship was soon manufactured in limited numbers for the needs of intelligence. Blueprints were directed to the Mercenary Centre, especially for pilots loyal to the Empire.

[h1]Let's take a look on the 3D-model of Imperial interceptor ‘Cyning’! [url=https://skfb.ly/HOvM]HERE![/url][/h1]

This is a densely populated system under control of the Federation. It houses many mines and processing rigs of all kinds. In fact, Velorum is one of the most valuable systems of Federation, and because of this it's often attacked.

The Cartel has been targeting a large mining station and a water harvest base for many years, and the Aliens often appear in the border zones. The federation regularly sends mercenaries on missions in Velorum, but somehow they are not too eager to clean it up completely.

notes.title: Forward to the Future!
notes.content:
[img]http://img.targem.ru/images/15c34e14179f07f55a587af148ff.png[/img]

[b]Pilots![/b]
Today, on the 21st of October 2015, is the fateful day where Marty McFly and Dr. Emmett Brown jumped from 1985 in the second part of the legendary trilogy ‘Back to the Future.’ We decided not to leave this event unnoticed.
 
‘The way I see it, if you're gonna build a time machine into a car, why not do it with some style?’ - Doc Brown.
 
But what if you build a spaceship into a car? Can you make that stylish? Let’s see if you can in our competition! We offer you to turn a DeLorean into a spacecraft, using your imagination and the basic skills of working with graphics editors.

notes.title: 3D Model of ‘Ronin’
notes.content:
[img]http://img.targem.ru/images/1aae4a4b739897e60a0104f5b927.png[/img]


[h1]Pilots, Let's take a look on the 3D-model of Jericho guard frigate ‘Ronin’! [url=https://skfb.ly/HGVQ]HERE![/url][/h1]

‘Ronin’ guard frigate had become the latest development of Jericho's Liu family before it was eradicated. Collapse of the Monolith also took down the laboratories, which developed this powerful machine. Fortunately, the ship's blueprints remained intact ‘Ronin’ was successfully recreated. However, scientists of other families have not been able to understand exactly how this machine works. It is unlikely that in the near future they will be able to create anything like it. The first ships of this series were given to the few surviving Liu warriors, who, deprived of their master and their home went on a journey through the galaxy. One of these warriors joined the mercenaries and handed the ship's blueprints to UMC for his newfound brothers to use.

notes.title: 3D model of ‘Jaguar’
notes.content:
[img]http://img.targem.ru/images/691a454db1699a1b54ece85942d3.jpg[/img]

‘Jaguar’ was conceived as a research vehicle that could observe the behavior of Aliens in extreme conditions. The ship's development was conducted simultaneously in several private laboratories. The project was led personally by Dr. Anton Pavlov, a well-known xenologist, Federation's chief Precursor specialist. The first prototype showed top efficiency in the flight tests. Shortly thereafter, Federation's government bought the laboratory that carried out the research through private investors, and ‘Jaguar’ got re-developed for military purposes. Pavlov immediately left the project, but by the time the bulk of development was already completed. When ‘Jaguar’ went into mass production, the Federation was forced to give mercenaries access to the ship, to somehow recoup the costs.

[h1]Mercenaries, explore the cool 3D model of ‘Jaguar’[url=https://skfb.ly/HBLY]HERE![/url][/h1]

notes.title: 3D model of Saw One
notes.content:
[img]http://img.targem.ru/images/9ec10fe91aeb3ff439342cabf451.png[/img]
The latest Jericho fighter called ‘Saw One’ is a magnificent example of the advanced technology of the Departed. Unfortunately, the price was high for its power. Two large laboratories were completely destroyed when the ship was activated during testing. More than forty engineers and countless pilots died trying to curb the vessel.
What else could be expected when the head of the Mendes family ordered to reconstruct the remaining Defiler mechanisms? Family Council abandoned the project, and the Mendes family had to finish it themselves. When ‘Saw One’ was finished, the family presented the ship to most desperate mercenaries. Well, if anyone can point its destructive power in the right direction — it's them.

[h1]Mercenaries, explore the cool 3D model of Saw One [url=https://sketchfab.com/models/add564b0c6044d80bb662ef7bf4d507e]HERE![/url][/h1]

notes.title: 3D Model of Kraken
notes.content:
[img]http://img.targem.ru/images/905be0b8bf09d20d22647123ea2b.png[/img]

Long-range frigate ‘Kraken’ was created under the watchful eye of the Imperial secret service. This vessel was designed without the use of any Alien technology, with one simple purpose — destroy the invaders. To everyone's surprise, the ‘Pure’ terrestrial technology, turned out not to be inferior compared to Alien tech. 
While Jericho and Federation were busy adjusting to new xenotech discoveries, Empire continued to stick to their line. And it came to fruition — the destructive power of Kraken's main caliber is superior to all modern models. ‘Kraken’ is currently undergoing flight tests and calibration of equipment with the most trusted mercenaries of the Empire.

[h1]Mercenaries, explore the cool 3D model of Kraken [url=https://sketchfab.com/models/e9d484b843474ad587e72ffb8463cafe]HERE![/url][/h1]

notes.title: Location Monolith Remains - Panorama
notes.content:
[img]http://img.targem.ru/images/354be2f2f2852af1a68209dff4e4.png[/img]

Majestic Monolith, a drifting Jericho colony of the Liu family, the pride of the Departed’s fleet. Monolith used to carry weapons comparable with a whole fleet, and its population was not inferior to some planetary colonies. Although It was not the largest Jericho city, Monolith was considered a holy place. Legend says Bartle himself used it to leave Earth. Monolith served as a place of worship, and it was the main temple of the strange Jericho religion. It was a hub of industry and trade and had the most modern laboratories.

notes.title: 3D model of Peregrine
notes.content:
[img]http://img.targem.ru/images/ac242b60aec92b1659ddd120e3cf.png[/img]

This unusual Federation interceptor was designed according to special order from a certain patron, who wished to remain anonymous. The task was very simple: to use all the latest Federation technology in a small ship. When the first prototype of the ‘Peregrine’ was assembled, the engineers found that they simply did not have a sufficiently powerful on-board computer to control all the systems. But the project had to be completed, so the engineers had a tough decision to make. They copied biomorph technology and replaced all of the ship's wiring with an organic neural network. The on-board computer became a bionic brain. Naturally, the vessel did not have a complete artificial intelligence, yet in testing it proved to be quite... predatory. The assembled ship's blueprints have been donated to the Federation fleet and UMC.

[h1]Mercenaries, explore the cool 3D model of Peregrine [url=https://sketchfab.com/models/b9f7850e62a748d1a01ef7fb7c19ad09]HERE![/url][/h1]

notes.title: Star Conflict 1.2
notes.content:
[img]http://img.targem.ru/images/2e7943dd7eea3060b0ad8ee17cb8.png[/img]

Cry 'Havoc!', and let slip the dogs of war’
William Shakespeare's ‘Julius Caesar’

Dogs of War, mercenaries ... Since the times of Direktorium they have been doing the dirty work. Governments fall and new ones take their place. The Empire, the noble lion, tangled with the sly fox, the Federation, and both of them bared their teeth at the monstrous chimera of Jericho. And mercenaries... they were just dogs to them, ones that change hands at the first opportunity. Authorities have never seen them as a serious force and tried to keep them on a leash. Yet their services are always in demand.

[h1]More information [url=https://forum.star-conflict.com/index.php?/topic/28052-star-conflict-12/]HERE![/url][/h1]

notes.title: Release anniversary!
notes.content:
[img]https://embed.gyazo.com/37065f57a4ac8aaf66363b4a3800d7cc.png[/img]

A year ago, on September 4, 2014, we officially released Star Conflict. We’ve had a year of capturing beacons, fighting against Aliens, exploring space, glorious victories and incredible defeats.
Over the past year we have seen battles of mighty dreadnoughts, struggle against the Defiler and numerous intriguing rounds on the tournament circuit. We added the pinnacle of ship designs — ‘secret projects’, a number of new battlegrounds, and other innovations — everything that makes our game universe the way it is now.

notes.content:

Compose short slogans that can inspire all mercenaries of the universe.

notes.title: 3D model of AJF-12 «Dvergr»
notes.content:
[img] http://img.targem.ru/images/fc29d94d99bd310be9bfaec5c67c.png [/img]

Pilots! Today we present to you a revamped version of the ship AJF-12 ‘Dvergr’. 
The ships is ready for production on all Imperial shipyards. Production starts with this update.
After the start of the Invasion, the already strong military industry of the Empire began to receive increased funding. Production lines and technology got a boost, quality control was also increased. Innovation, however, affected not only the advanced developments, but also the ‘workhorses’, such as the fighter ‘Dvergr’. The training fighter got a new polymer lining, more efficient engine and even air conditioning in the cockpit. And all this without increasing the cost! ‘Dvergr’ remains as reliable and unpretentious, as it was before.

notes.title: Secret ship pursuit
notes.content:
[img]http://img.targem.ru/images/fd9b256402fe97552546600960b7.png[/img]

Cryptogram AsII14-567834
From: Ms. Summer
To: all@pilots_star_conflict
CC: Центр наемников
Sent: Thursday, July, 9, 2015
Subject: Secret ship pursuit

Attention, Mercenaries!

Very soon my personal shipyard will be completed with the first Nyx-class ships.

Nyx is a tech level 3 ship. Some technology I ‘borrowed’ from Jericho, something I inherited from a modified Jericho interceptor ‘Karud’. All the insides of the ship are based on external tech. Special experimental modules that provide an additional advantage in combat and long-range raids are included with the ship.

This is a unique ship. And I know that many of you can’t wait to add ‘Nyx’ to your fleet. Well, you’re going to have to work for that! Only the most responsible and diligent pilots will get the ship when the job is done.

Remember, I need all kinds of intelligence, as well as ship sensor readings during flights. The data will be collected automatically whenever you perform my tasks.

All you need is to actively participate in PvP combat, PvE missions and explore open space. The more the better!

Miss Summer

[h1]Details on the website:  [url=http://star-conflict.com/en/news/510-secret-ship-pursuit-en]HERE![/url][/h1]

notes.title: 3D model of GF-17 "Hydra 2"
notes.content:
[img]http://img.targem.ru/images/e952c29023201f06b81ab927c94b.png[/img]

Legion command is particularly concerned with maintaining its technological superiority. One of the main challenges was the need to replace the obsolete project ‘Iron Harpy’. After learning about the development of the Army project ‘Hydra’, Legion design bureau sped up work in this area, and in the end it produced a frigate that showed excellent results during tests. It was taken into service under callsign Invincible Legion GF-17 ‘Hydra 2’. Nevertheless, the frigate was quite expensive, so for a long time the Legion squadrons were made up of different ships.

notes.title: 3D model of JT-1X "Cutter"
notes.content:
[img]http://img.targem.ru/images/8f12b2d38a2e2b5fb9ffcb69afa7.png[/img]

This ship — is a completely independent project by the Techs faction. After careful examination of the ships ‘Sawtooth’ and ‘Blood Tormentor’ a scaled-down and more efficient cooling system was recreated to perfectly suit the powerful and compact new engine. The result exceeded all expectations. The ship's power plant is ahead of almost all its counterparts mounted on other interceptors. A special group of designers worked on the appearance of the ship. As a result, the ship looks aggressive and defiant. The first pilot to encounter ‘Cutter’, were so surprised by the interceptor's appearance that they claimed they were attacked by space insects.

notes.content:

notes.title: 3D Model of Razor
notes.content:
[img]http://img.targem.ru/images/61399e87f95aa7f257dbbc9d77e8.png[/img]

The Razor is the first example of an attack craft built with a powerful neural matrix in its core. This matrix allows pilots to remotely connect to the aircraft in just a few seconds. The link between pilot and ship is so strong that when the ship is damaged the pilot feels pain, even if he's millions of kilometers away from the battlefield. The developers sought to push the link between man and machine to the limit, resulting in a ship that is extremely difficult to use for all but the best of pilots.

notes.title: New Patch Star Conflict v.1.1.4
notes.content:
[img]http://img.targem.ru/images/03f8f2cd0a791cb4235345b13094.png[/img]

Pilots! In today's update the game gets two brand-new Empire and Federation fighters, as well as three new modules for your ships! Corporate dreadnoughts will also receive new modules. 

As for the global map of corporate control over sectors, T4 level locations will become available for capture. We also fixed several important bugs, and made changes to the gameplay ‘Capture the beacons’. 

All corporation pilots, who managed to build dreadnoughts during the competition ‘Arms race’ will receive a special commemorative achievement ‘Space Engineers’

notes.title: Final Dreadnought Construction Stage!
notes.content:
[img]http://img.targem.ru/images/0821df7168ffdf26d042b136472e.png[/img]

[h1]Attention to all corporations! Access is now open to the fourth stage of dreadnought construction — ‘Construction completion and weaponry mounting’.[/h1]

Time for construction process — one week. All shipyards received the final packages with dreadnought blueprints. Hull and weapons will be mounted during the final construction stage.
 
[b]Warning![/b] The success of the installation directly affects the dreadnought's combat capabilities.
 
This is the final stage of construction. When all the modules are installed, a dreadnought is considered to be ready for future battles. You can send your Dreadnought into battle when the fourth phase of construction is officially finished, and all the corporations with their own dreadnoughts will be ready for a new war.

In a week we will conclude the Arms Race and find out which corporations are going to be the first to fight for control over sectors.

[url=https://forum.star-conflict.com/index.php?/topic/26837-final-dreadnought-construction-stage/]Read more[/url]

notes.title: Announcement: Star Conflict Update
notes.content:
[img]http://img.targem.ru/images/9be4692651450f2f24eb9bb097b5.png[/img]

Pilots!

This week you can expect some stunning changes! After working so hard we were able to present you the mighty Dreadnoughts. However, we had missed some important points and would like to fix that in this patch.

Just today it was announced that biomorphs infected tech engineering products of each side of conflict. All of your weaponry is now infected with a mysterious alien plague, which is dangerous for you! Engineers are trying to find a cure for it, but it takes time. There is a theory however, that vaccine could be developed, but it would require your help and professional pilot skills. Everything is in your claws!


[url=https://forum.star-conflict.com/index.php?/topic/26643-announce-star-conflict-patch/]Read more[/url]

notes.title: Referral program
notes.content:
[img]http://img.targem.ru/images/42433db00ff15ba0bc93c2e68864.png[/img]

We continue developing and perfecting rewards for attracting new players. Pilots can now get Galactic Standards for helping the players they brought to the game:

- 50 GS when the invitee reaches rank 6
- 250 GS when the invitee reaches rank 9
- 500 GS when the invitee reaches rank 12

Star Conflict team is very happy when our pilots create various amazing and useful tools for our community and we are always glad to support these endeavors! One of our players with call sign [b]Eta[/b] has created a great instrument* for you, allowing creation of [b]Star Conflict-themed avatars and userbars[/b]! Best regards,
Star Conflict Team

notes.title: 'International Children's Day' with Star Conflict!
notes.content:
[img=http://img.targem.ru/images/b7bda9d129b4ae95b11d1d9654b0.jpg]

[h1]Pilots![/h1]

Meet [b]'International Children's Day'[/b] with Star Conflict! Tough pro's will be able to share their wisdom and skill, and new players will learn something new! This weekend our players will be able to get a unique achievement and of course, there will be some interesting offers! 

Experienced mercs will have an opportunity to show new players how 'grown-ups' fight: should you have a pilot in your squad, whose rating is 300 points lower than yours, and win the battle with him, you will get a [b]unique achievement 'Child Defender'.[/b]

Hurry up - you can become 'Child Defender' only [b]until 4 a.m. UTC, June 2nd.[/b]

Along with this mini-event, we will also have a 'training' tiers ship sale, you will get:

[b]- 50% Discount on ALL T1 and T2 ships;
- 30% Discount on 7-day Premium-license.[/b]

All our pilots will have an opportunity to try new ships and find roles that are fitting their gameplay style the most! Take this chance and get the most interesting T1 and T2 ships!

Best regards,
Star Conflict Team.

notes.title: 'Victory Day' Events!
notes.content:
[img=http://i.imgur.com/TOQUhNR.jpg?1?7007]

These days will be indeed great time for the whole Planet, pilots! 
Star Conflict Team congratulates you with [b]Victory Day![/b]

And to commemorate The Day we would like to make a specail offer to all of you! So, without further ado: 

[h1]9th and 10th of May:[/h1][list]
[b][*]Bonus х5 to all rewards for First Victory
[*]Discount on ALL T1 premium-ships - they will cost 500 Galactic Standards
[*]Discount on ALL T2 premium-ships - only 900 Galactic Standards
[*]A SPECIAL DISCOUNT on T3-5 premium-ships - 1945 Galactic Standards[/b][/list]

[h1]11th of May:[/h1]
In conclusion of May sales, we would like to announce that this whole day you will have "Golden Battles"! You will be winning special rewards for your fights! 

Rules are very simple:
[list][b][*]50 Galactic Standards for 3 victories
[*]100 Galactic Standards for 5 victories
[*]150 Galactic Standards for 10 victories
[*]200 Galactic Standards for 20 victories[/b][/list]

'Golden Battles' will start at 20-00GMT May 10th, and will last till 23-59GMT May 11th.

By fighting and winning on that day you can get up to 500 Galactic Standards! Good luck in battles, pilots!

notes.title: Take part in our cool 'Photochop' contest!
notes.content:
[h1]Pilots![/h1]

We are launching a creative contest [b]"Photochop"![/b]

Manipulate [url=http://star-conflict.com/upload/image/Events/astronaut.png]this image[/url] using any kind of graphics editing software and publish the result on our [url=https://www.facebook.com/StarConflict]Facebook page[/url] or here, in our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/212070/images/]Group's Album[/url], the original you can find below. All works will be collected in special Facebook’s album.

Humor and high quality will add more points to your picture. Your creativity is only limited by your imagination! What is "Photochop"?
[b][list][*]1st place - 6000 Galactic Standards;
[*]2nd place - 4000 Galactic Standards;
[*]3rd place - 2500 Galactic Standards;[/list][/b]
A special award "People's Choice Award" in 2000 Galactic Standards to the player, whose job will have more "likes" in the album.

Terms:
1. The contest will run until April 8. Winners will be chosen on 10th of April.
2. One participant - one picture.
3. Add the author's nickname, the picture’s name is optional.
4. Picture should be either JPG or PNG.
5. Organizers may ask you for all original materials used. It is forbidden to use other people's work!
6. You automatically pass exclusive rights to the image to organizers of the contest by posting the picture in the thread.
7. Image should be created exclusively for the contest.
8. Image should not break any rules of morale, ethics or law (domestic or international), as well as game rules.
9. Winners are chosen by Star Conflict administration.
The authors of the best works that were not included in the top three will also be rewarded!

[url=http://forum.star-conflict.com/index.php?/topic/22841-contest-%E2%80%98photochop%E2%80%99-discussion/]You can discuss news here![/url]

notes.title: 'Voice Control' Feature!
notes.content:
[img=http://img.targem.ru/images/82b9f1d8890b3c77dc42fd260833.jpg]

Pilots! As you know, yesterday we have stopped the game servers in order to install a small update! What was in it? Star Gem Games is happy to announce that in continuation of our work over 'Voice Chat' feature we have finished our work on additional feature called 'Voice Control'! This feature was activated yesterday during the update, and you just need to get into the game with any recording device plugged in and try it out yourself!

Here's a short list of commands:

[b]Bots, beacon A/B/C - bots start moving towards one of the designated beacons. 
Bots, protect - one bot in the vicinity starts protecting your ship
Eyes on target - your target lightens up 
Eyes on me - your ship lightens up
Missiles - your ship fires installed missiles
Afterburner - your ship's thrusters start/stop working.
Eject - you are leaving the ship[/b]

You may familiarize yourself with a full list of commands in our game, in menu 'Voice Control'!

Don't forget to use these unique commands: 
[b]- Bots, transform!
- Au revoir! 
- Do the barrell roll![/b]

You can try out the 'Voice Control' feature right now!

Insincerely,

notes.title: 'Voice Control' Feature!
notes.content:
[img=http://img.targem.ru/images/82b9f1d8890b3c77dc42fd260833.jpg]

Pilots! As you know, yesterday we have stopped the game servers in order to install a small update! What was in it? Star Gem Games is happy to announce that in continuation of our work over 'Voice Chat' feature we have finished our work on additional feature called 'Voice Control'! This feature was activated yesterday during the update, and you just need to get into the game with any recording device plugged in and try it out yourself!

Here's a short list of commands:

[b]Bots, beacon A/B/C - bots start moving towards one of the designated beacons. 
Bots, protect - one bot in the vicinity starts protecting your ship
Eyes on target - your target lightens up 
Eyes on me - your ship lightens up
Missiles - your ship fires installed missiles
Afterburner - your ship's thrusters start/stop working.
Eject - you are leaving the ship[/b]

You may familiarize yourself with a full list of commands in our game, in menu 'Voice Control'!

Don't forget to use these unique commands: 
[b]- Bots, transform!
- Au revoir! 
- Do the barrell roll![/b]

You can try out the 'Voice Control' feature right now!

Insincerely, 
Star Conflict Team

notes.title: Contest ‘Ancient Nomads’
notes.content:
[img=http://img.targem.ru/images/148886aa18061513266fc6ffa27c.jpg]

[h1]Pilots![/h1]

Our intelligence beacons just received a distress signal containing distorted information with signatures of unidentified ships. Despite the fact that it was possible to detect the region of space where the data was transmitted from fast enough, capture of unknown ships caused some difficulty — apparently part of the autonomous combat systems were still operational — the pilot who sent the first brief message about this discovery hasn't contacted us since.

Some researchers from our history department suggest that this squad, designation ‘Ancient Nomads’, could have been created before the First War! However, how it got into Precursor sectors remains a mystery.

Right now technological resources of the history department are fully focused on the search for the remaining records in the XXXVI century archives — the researchers think that they hold the Emperor's real name, so the department does not intend to redirect their efforts to anything else. However, as this finding is valuable for Command (during the time of the travel across the expanses of space and Precursor sectors, flight recorders must have collected a huge amount of strategic information), we offer mercenaries to participate in finding signatures of the ships in the archive!

Fleet Command does not want to put their pilots under threat, especially as history department has complete deactivation codes for onboard systems of almost all known types of ships. These codes will be transferred to the ‘Nomads’ using unmanned transmitters. However, it is necessary to know their models.

[h1]You will be given access to the archive that selects a ship model according to different variants of the name! For more information look at the briefing below.

[b][url=http://forum.star-conflict.com/index.php?/topic/22560-contest-%E2%80%98ancient-nomads%E2%80%99/]Briefing[/url][/b][/h1]

notes.title: 2 years in space - all systems nominal!
notes.content:
[img=http://img.targem.ru/images/4daa0d26f6f2c4c4e805b805d7b3.jpg]

Pilots! 

Two years ago, on February, 1st, we have started working on 'Star Conflict'! And this weekend, to celebrate this splendid event, we would like to present our players with gifts dedicated to this particular date:

We have doubled all your income:
[b]x2 to synergy gain in battles
x2 to synergy extraction
x2 to loyalty gain from contracts[/b]

And cut twice all your expenses:
[b]- 50% discount on ALL ships, including premiums
- 50% discount on ALL weapons
- 50% discount on ALL weapon upgrades in credits, GS and artifacts[/b]

Use this great opportunity and celebrate 'Star Conflict' birthday with us! 

Sincerely, 
Star Conflict Team

notes.title: Best pilot Snow74Leopard!
notes.content:
[h1]Pilots![/h1]

Upon examination of pilots' personal records, Command Officials have established that mercenary [b][u]Snow74Leopard[/u][/b] was first to achieve [b]maximum synergy with all of the ships[/b]! He is also the very first pilot to collect the [b]biggest fleet[/b] in Precursors' Sectors!

In order to acknowledge this outstanding alacrity, the Command has issued a decree, awarding this pilot with [b]Extended License for 1820 days (5 years)[/b] as well as handing him over a unique piece of artifact equipment - system [b]'Positronic Destructor TG-18'[/b]

We would like to congratulate Snow74Leopard and wish him clear space and honourable foes!

Sincerely,
Star Conflict Team

[img=http://img.targem.ru/images/f8a6ceb0b9a6f0438e0b422227c1.jpg]

notes.title: Список изменений в Обновлении 0.9.7.
notes.content:
[b]Star Conflict OBT v.0.9.7[/b]

[b]Геймплей[/b]
Настройка сложности миссий PvE: Верфь «Блэквуд», Добывающая станция
Свой бой: теперь возможно создать свою миссию PvE для троих пилотов
Доработана карта Ледяной риф:
[list][*]Изменена геометрия ледяных астероидов[/list]
Оптимизирована производительность
Обучение игре: теперь за успешное прохождение третьего этапа обучения пилоту выплачивается 100 ГС.
Средняя доходность премиум-кораблей повышена на 20%

[b]Ангар[/b]
Теперь окно поиска контрактов может быть свернуто щелчком по свободной области экрана
Верфь
В контекстное меню корабля добавлен пункт "Снять всё"
Теперь в описании орудий отображается величина бонуса критического урона

[b]Оформление[/b]
Стоимость черного и красного цвета при перекрашивании корабля увеличена в 2 раза

[b]Графика[/b]
Переработан эффект выстрела Атакующий дрон
Доработка эффектов взрывов

[b]HUD[/b]
Добавлен центральный элемент
Цвет маркера упреждения изменен на белый

[b]Звук[/b]
Переделан звук "Плазменной дуги"
Доработан звук в Ангаре: теперь меньше низких частот
Доработана озвучка
Добавлен новый музыкальный трек
Доработка громкости звуковых эффектов

[b]Работа над ошибками[/b]
Исправлена ошибка, с исчезновением информации об учебной цели в обучающих боях
Улучшена производительность графики на интегрированных видеокартах Intel, не имеющих поддержки MSAA
Исправлено редкое падение при запуске тренировочного боя
Исправлена ошибка, при которой можно было вылететь в учебный бой на кораблях, находящихся в другом бою
Исправлена ошибка, при которой не засчитывалось выполнение контракта "Крепкая основа"
Исправлена ошибка, при которой была возможность дважды потратить ГС на смену тега корпорации
Теперь тултип Система «Валькирия» отображает затраты энергии на активацию модуля
Теперь, если нажать F11 на экран дополнительно будет выводиться информация о регионе, в котором расположен сервер

[b]Добавлены новые опции:[/b]
"Донаводка прицела": позволяет включить или выключить автоматическое донаведение прицела на маркер упреждения цели
"Учет задержки в упреждении": позволяет включить или выключить учет задержки прохождения пакетов через сеть (лага) при расчете положения маркера упреждения цели
Начальное значение опций соответствует версии 0.9.5

notes.content:

As we all know, there is no doubt that extraterrestrial life exists, and that aliens from other planets have been living among us. Some people think that they can hide the truth from us, but we are not fooled! Let's show the world that we know the truth!

[List]

Your best friend or acquaintance, your pet or you yourself are not from this planet? It's time to tell the truth!

[/list]

notes.title: "Knowledge Day" Event!
notes.content:
[img=http://img.targem.ru/images/598b99e71a9d624b380a8ba754cf.jpg]

[h1][b]Pilots![/b][/h1]

Spacefleet command has announced the start of celebrations of the ancient holiday "Knowledge Day"! Young pilots used to start their first test flights exactly on this day! To remind all our veterans of the past, the command has prepared a set of achievements and titles that they will be able to get in battle! Hurry, you can only get these titles for a limited period!

So, here's the list of achievements and the conditions that must be met to obtain them:

[list]
[*][b]Xenobiologist[/b]
[*][b]Underachiever[/b]
[*][b]Bully[/b]
[*][b]Monitor[/b]
[*][b]Instructor[/b]
[*][b]Cosmonerd[/b]
[*][b]Space Cadet[/b]
[*][b]Ensign[/b]
[/list]

[b]Sensei[/b] - is the final title given only the most motivated pilots — you can get it for unlocking all 8 achievements of the "Knowledge Day" event.

[b]Pilots, hurry:[/b] festivities will take place from August 30 to September 6, inclusive, and then getting the achievements and the titles will be impossible! But the ones you manage to unlock will remain forever!
 
After the event, all pilots who have acquired a "Sensei" achievement will also recieve a unique permanent sticker for their ships!
 
Spacefleet command wishes you a Happy holiday and success both in training and in actual combat missions!

Here you can find [url=http://forum.star-conflict.com/index.php?/topic/21159-knowledge-day-event-discussion/]full version of the news[/url]!

notes.title: Праздник "День знаний"!
notes.content:
[img=http://img.targem.ru/images/db688f78af09096132c1bae241ff.jpg]

[h1][b]Пилоты![/b][/h1]

Командование флота объявляет о подготовке к старинному празднику "День Знаний"! Именно в эти дни юные пилоты отправлялись в свои первые учебные полеты! Чтобы напомнить всем нашим ветеранам о былом, командование подготовило набор достижений и званий, которые они смогут получить в бою! Спешите, получить эти звания можно только в течение ограниченного срока!

Итак вы сможете получить следующие достижения:

[list]
[*][b]Ксенобиолог[/b]
[*][b]Второгодник[/b]
[*][b]Задира[/b]
[*][b]Староста[/b]
[*][b]Инструктор[/b]
[*][b]Космоботан[/b]
[*][b]Кадет[/b]
[*][b]Юнкер[/b]
[/list]

За получение всех этих достижений выдается финальное звание - [b]Сенсей[/b]

Пилоты, поторопитесь: праздничные мероприятия пройдут с 30 августа по 6 сентября включительно, после этого срока получить достижения и звания будет невозможно! Но все полученные за время акции звания останутся навсегда!

Кроме этого, после окончания празднования, все пилоты, заработавшие звание "Сенсей" получат в награду уникальную постоянную наклейку!

Командование поздравляет вас с наступающим праздником и желает успехов как в тренировочных, так и в реальных боевых вылетах!

Тут вы можете [url=http://forum.star-conflict.ru/index.php?/topic/36693-%D0%BF%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B7%D0%B4%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%BA-%D0%B4%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%8C-%D0%B7%D0%BD%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%B9/]найти полную новость[/url]

notes.title: Summer is here!
notes.content:
Dear friends! We congratulate you on the arrival of the long-awaited summer and wish you a warm and jolly mood!
To help you get even more out of this joyous event, we a summer event!

We award gold to the winners! 20 gold for your second victory and 200 gold for your fifth victory!

We will also have a 25% discount on the following modules technological levels of T3 and T4 during the whole event:
Special modules for ECM Interceptors:
- Energy Absorber
- Weapon System Inhibitor
- Ion Emitter
- Stasis Generator
Special modules for Covert Ops Interceptors:
- “Orion” Targeting Complex
- Adaptive Camouflage
- “WHite Noise” Jammer
- Plasma Arc
- “Kamikaze” System
Special modules for Recon Interceptors:
- Parasitic Remodulator
- Phase Modulator
- Micro-locator
- Spy Drone Container

The event is on from 31.05.13 16:00 GMT till 03/06/13 9:00 GMT

Stay with us this weekend!

A clean space to you!

Sincerely,
Star Conflict team

notes.title: == Star Conflict v 0.7.10 Update # 1 ==
notes.content:
Game servers will be restarted to apply a hotfix
Expected downtime is about 30 minutes

Here is the list of changes to be made:

Game balance: Battle search, matchmaking
* Carried out improvements to reduce the probability of battle creation failure.

Contracts: General
* Increased the fee for short-term contracts.
- Reduced contract cooldowns. (Not Fixed. Will be implemented in the next update, sorry for disinformation)
* Reputation bonus from the Steam DLC now also increases loyalty gains.

Interface: General
* Returned to the old font.
* Added a space between the player and his message.
